title: Corporate team building
reason: 昨天的课程聚焦数字学习工具，今天轮换到项目管理和团队协作。本集以多种企业团建活动讨论团队如何建立连接、跨越背景差异并提升合作效率，适合迁移到平台建设、跨部门项目和工程管理场景。练习选择原文中可直接用于会议、协作和方案评价的高频表达，通过多次受控调用后再进入有限迁移。

targetExpressions.meaning: cooperate with someone in a way that produces better results
targetExpressions.usage: Use it when discussing improved collaboration: We need to work more effectively with the operations team.

targetExpressions.expression: work well together as a team
targetExpressions.usage: Use it to describe good teamwork: Clear roles help people work well together as a team.

targetExpressions.meaning: stop discussing one subject and start the next one
targetExpressions.usage: Use it to guide a meeting or presentation: Let's move on to the deployment plan.

targetExpressions.meaning: copy or be guided by another person's actions
targetExpressions.usage: Use it when one person provides an example: The new team followed her lead and documented every decision.

targetExpressions.meaning: something especially suitable for a particular purpose or situation
targetExpressions.usage: Use it to evaluate suitability: A short workshop may be a perfect fit for this small team.

targetExpressions.meaning: connect with someone and develop a good working relationship
targetExpressions.usage: Use it for relationships within a group: New colleagues often need time to gel with the rest of the team.

objectiveQuestions.prompt: Complete Neil's goal: He hoped for tips on how to ______ his co-presenter.
objectiveQuestions.explanation: Neil says he was hoping for tips on how to work more effectively with his co-presenter.

objectiveQuestions.prompt: According to the programme, what is the purpose of team building?
objectiveQuestions.targetExpression: work well together as a team

options.text: To encourage employees to work well together through shared activities
To test which employee can complete every task alone
To replace normal work with permanent entertainment
To teach employees only physical exercise

objectiveQuestions.explanation: Sophie defines team building as encouraging employees to work well together as a team by engaging them in different activities.

objectiveQuestions.prompt: Complete Neil's transition to a new topic: “So let's ______ and have today's quiz question.”
objectiveQuestions.explanation: Neil uses move on to stop discussing the unusual awayday examples and introduce the quiz question.

objectiveQuestions.prompt: Why were stressed-out city workers “following their lead” in the programme?

options.text: They were copying Bill Gates and Warren Buffett by trying the ukulele.
They were training horses to recognise cultural differences.
They were organising compulsory English lessons.
They were refusing to join any team activity.

objectiveQuestions.explanation: The transcript says Bill Gates and Warren Buffett play the ukulele and stressed-out city workers are following their lead.

objectiveQuestions.prompt: Complete Kelly Eide's evaluation: Because horses ignore age, gender, religion and tradition, the activity is ______ for culturally diverse groups.
objectiveQuestions.explanation: Kelly says horse training transcends cultural boundaries, so it is a perfect fit for groups whose members have no common norms.

objectiveQuestions.prompt: What does it mean for people from different backgrounds to “gel with” one another?

options.text: They connect and develop a good relationship.
They compete to become the only leader.
They agree to keep their backgrounds secret.

objectiveQuestions.explanation: Neil directly explains that to gel with someone means to connect or get on well with that person.

objectiveQuestions.prompt: Which activity was introduced in China in 1951 as compulsory for workers?
objectiveQuestions.targetExpression: work well together as a team
objectiveQuestions.explanation: The quiz answer is calisthenics, a form of gentle physical exercise used to build morale, group unity and energy.

objectiveQuestions.prompt: Which sentence uses “a perfect fit” naturally?

options.text: A short retrospective is a perfect fit for this experienced project team.
A short retrospective perfects a fit for the team.
The team is a fit perfectly the retrospective.
A short retrospective fits perfect with a team.

objectiveQuestions.explanation: A perfect fit naturally follows be and means something is especially suitable for a situation or purpose.

assessment.retellingPrompt: Without looking at the full transcript, retell the episode in 80–120 words using this structure: (1) topic—what team building aims to achieve; (2) examples—ukulele sessions and horse-based leadership training; (3) conclusion—why an activity may or may not suit a team. Phrase bank: “work well together as a team”, “follow someone's lead”, “a perfect fit”. Use at least two phrases naturally. Simple, accurate sentences are enough.
referencePoints: Team building aims to help employees work well together through shared activities away from ordinary work.
The programme mentions combat games, zombie boot camps and crime investigations as unusual awayday activities.
Some companies use ukulele sessions because the instrument is easy to start, non-competitive and less intimidating than a guitar.
Stressed city workers followed the lead of Bill Gates and Warren Buffett by trying the ukulele.
Horse-based leadership training uses body language and is presented as crossing boundaries of age, gender, religion and tradition.
The horse-training company says the method can help people from different backgrounds gel, while the presenters note that doing this may be difficult.
